archetypes.name: dyn-bgjob-proc
archetypes.rationale: Real-process bgjob coverage depends on process identity and cleanup behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new scripts/test-bgjob.sh harness for real-process correctness, cleanup reliability, and macOS Bash 3.2 compatibility. Pay particular attention to owner-orphan, timeout, daemon-death, and reap-safety cases, including whether the harness can falsely pass or leave child process groups behind. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
